items.headline: Tornado Watch issued October 11 at 4:59PM EDT until October 11 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
TORNADO WATCH 681 REMAINS VALID UNTIL 8 PM EDT THIS EVENING FOR
THE FOLLOWING AREAS

THIS WATCH INCLUDES THE FOLLOWING ADJACENT COASTAL WATERS

S OF OREGON INLET TO CAPE HATTERAS NC OUT 20 NM
S OF CAPE HATTERAS TO OCRACOKE INLET NC OUT 20 NM
INCLUDING THE MONITOR NATIONAL MARINE SANCTUARY
S OF OCRACOKE INLET TO CAPE LOOKOUT NC OUT 20 NM

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 11 at 12:01PM EDT until October 12 at 2:00PM EDT by NWS Newport/Morehead City NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Southwest winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt and
seas 6 to 9 ft.

* WHERE...The coastal waters from Oregon Inlet to Ocracoke Inlet.

* WHEN...Until 2 PM EDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
